d:
A beautiful song on Army Man's separation from his lover, soulfully sung by Arijit Singh & composed by Pritam, while its Lyrics are penned by Irshad Kamil.
Song: Ashq Na Ho - Full Video
Singer - Arijit Singh
Lyrics - Irshad Kamil
Movie : "HOLIDAY" - A Soldier Is Never Off Duty
Starring : Akshay Kumar, Sonakshi Sinha
Directed : A.R. Murugadoss
Producer : Aruna Bhatia, Vipul Shah, Reliance Entertainment
